analysis.market_summary: Nifty extended its slide (-0.53% to 23,771.55, -1.28% over 5 days) as crude-driven West Asia tensions and Fed rate-hike jitters weighed on sentiment, with IT stocks bearing the brunt of the selloff. RBI held rates steady while projecting 6.9% GDP growth, offering a stabilizing macro backdrop even as the index tests key technical support near 23,600-23,800. Defensive/domestic-cyclical names (defense, cement, banks) held up better than export-linked IT, which fell 2-4% on Fed-driven dollar strength fears.

picks.name: Larsen & Toubro
picks.thesis: L&T was upgraded to Buy on improved valuation and financial metrics per marketsmojo.com, and the stock rose +0.55% even as the broader index fell -0.53%, showing relative strength. Its infra/domestic-capex exposure insulates it from the IT-specific selloff driving today's weakness.
picks.catalysts: Analyst upgrade momentum, continued government capex spending, order-book updates
picks.risks: Broader market weakness from crude/Fed concerns could still drag large-caps lower; 5d trend still negative (-1.45%)

picks.name: Bharat Electronics
picks.thesis: BEL posted strong Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 25% YoY to ₹5,533 crore on strong execution, and the stock gained +0.39% despite the broader Sensex/Nifty selloff on crude/Fed concerns. It also features on lists of top PSU stocks to buy for September, indicating continued institutional interest in the defense theme.
picks.catalysts: Continued order execution, defense sector tailwinds, inclusion in PSU buy lists
picks.risks: 5d performance still negative (-1.81%), broader market risk-off sentiment could cap PSU rally

picks.name: Tata Steel
picks.thesis: Despite a -2.08% daily drop, Tata Steel reported Q1FY27 EBITDA rising 25% to ₹9,370 crore on India strength, and is rated Buy alongside JSW Steel amid 26% monthly coking-coal inflation supporting price targets. This looks like an overdone pullback given the strong fundamental print and positive analyst commentary.
picks.risks: Coking coal cost inflation could pressure margins if not passed through; steel sector sensitive to China demand and global commodity cycles
picks.catalysts: Price target upgrades from Business Today/Sahi, continued strong domestic EBITDA execution

picks.name: ICICI Bank
picks.thesis: ICICI Bank held up relatively well (+0.12% vs Nifty -0.53%) after LIC received RBI approval to raise its stake to 9.99%, a vote of confidence from India's largest insurer with ₹59.39 trillion AUM. Target prices are being revised upward as credit growth improves per Business Today.
picks.catalysts: LIC stake increase execution, credit growth acceleration, target price upgrades
picks.risks: 5d trend still down -2.00%; broader banking sector exposed to RBI liquidity/VRRR actions and rate uncertainty

picks.name: Tata Consumer Products
picks.thesis: Tata Consumer approved a ₹10 dividend at its 63rd AGM and rose +0.62% today, bucking the weak tape, while being named among Nifty50 stocks analysts suggest buying in this volatile week per Economic Times.
picks.catalysts: Dividend payout support, defensive consumer staples positioning amid volatility, analyst buy recommendations
picks.risks: 5d trend still negative (-2.04%), consumer staples sensitive to input cost/monsoon-linked demand shifts

watchlist.name: Apollo Hospitals
watchlist.reason: Modest +0.53% gain and featured in festive season stock-pick lists, but limited fresh fundamental news; 5d trend still down -2.28%.

watchlist.name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories
watchlist.reason: Slight gain (+0.46%) but US FDA Form 483 at Srikakulam unit and Torrent's separate injection recall in the sector are worth monitoring for read-through risk.

watchlist.name: HCLTech
watchlist.reason: Part of the broad IT selloff (-1.66%) tied to Fed rate concerns; watch for stabilization before considering entry given no company-specific negative news.

watchlist.name: UltraTech Cement
watchlist.reason: Down -1.50% with Q1FY27 results board meeting pending; featured in cement buy lists but no fresh catalyst yet.

avoid.name: Wipro
avoid.reason: Goldman Sachs maintains a Sell rating with a ₹172 target (about 3% downside), and the stock is down -1.80% daily and -6.11% over 5 days with no offsetting positive catalyst.

avoid.name: Jio Financial Services
avoid.reason: Despite Q1FY27 net profit rising 156% YoY, the stock is rated Sell by marketsmojo.com and fell -1.63%, suggesting the market/analysts see the earnings beat as already priced in or facing headwinds.

avoid.name: Infosys
avoid.reason: Biggest loser in the universe (-3.29% daily, -3.62% 5d) as Nifty IT tumbles on Fed rate-hike bets; no stock-specific positive catalyst to offset sector-wide pressure.
